revenueModel.text: Clients pay for customer engagement services through delivery of outsourced customer service and technical support across omni-channels, and for digital marketing and acquisition solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: ibex delivers end-to-end customer engagement, innovative business process outsourcing ("BPO"), smart digital marketing, online acquisition technology, and Artificial Intelligence ("AI") solutions to help companies acquire, engage, and retain valuable customers.

changes.text: In 2026, the company consolidated to a single reportable segment after previously reporting multiple segments.
